mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months indicates an accommodative monetary policy stance, which reduces the cost of capital and boosts equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and dampens corporate earnings growth, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in housing starts and retail sales indicates robust consumer spending, which accelerates corporate revenue growth and elevates equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is negative in more than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 3-month moving averages, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate profit growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production over the past 3 months reflects weakening economic output, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO has declined over the past 3 months, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts exceed 1,500,000 units per month for two consecutive months, it indicates strong residential construction activity, which supports consumer confidence and corporate capital expenditure, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST > 1500.0 (thousands of units) for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when HOUST > 1500.0 for two consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in inflation and federal funds rate signals aggressive monetary tightening to combat inflation, which increases real interest rates and reduces equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward return is positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2.0% and FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annualized), the strong economic momentum supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 growth rate > 3.0% annualized, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
